item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena shines a torch through a long pipe in her school corridor to see if the light reaches her friend Arjun at the other end.
In which situation will Arjun see the torch light?

options.A: when the pipe is bent in the middle but the torch is very bright
options.B: when the straight pipe is held so that Arjun's eye, the pipe and the torch are all in one line
options.C: when the pipe is curved and Arjun stands to one side of its end
options.D: when the straight pipe is tilted so its far end points away from Arjun's eye
